name: zclass_sound_set_position
description: zClass_Sound::gwSoundSetPosition stores the sound position and marks the runtime sound state dirty.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this sound setter; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass sound source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x452d00 validates null-node/null-data error return 5, writing x/y/z to the sound data local position fields, ORing runtime flags with 3, and returning 0.
The native smoke verifies local-position writes, dirty-flag update, successful return, and null/node-with-null-data error handling.
